design: Strongest fixed whole arm plus reference-free unscorable-output completion.

prefix_origin.reason: Live private SLAKE reply ID/usage/content differ from frozen published M baseline; live changed reply is not used.
prefix_origin.image_bytes: Restored from existing byte-preserving published assets.
prefix_origin.limitations: Published privacy/path transformations are retained; not claimed byte-identical private request metadata.

prompt_template: Your previous response did not complete the ORIGINAL task in the required output form. Re-examine the original question, supplied images and only tool observations actually returned. An unexecuted tool plan is not an observation. Return exactly one JSON object containing only string fields "answer" and "reason"; reason is one short sentence. The original question is binary; the answer must be Yes or No. Choose an answer only when supported by that question and evidence; do not invent findings. If unable to support a supplied answer, retain your previous answer in that JSON instead. No tools, code fences, or text outside the JSON.
prompt_mcq_template: Your previous response did not complete the ORIGINAL task in the required output form. Re-examine the original question, supplied images and only tool observations actually returned. An unexecuted tool plan is not an observation. Return exactly one JSON object containing only string fields "answer" and "reason"; reason is one short sentence. The answer must be one supplied option letter: A, B. Choose an answer only when supported by that question and evidence; do not invent findings. If unable to support a supplied answer, retain your previous answer in that JSON instead. No tools, code fences, or text outside the JSON.
reply_acceptance: Original exactM JSON schema plus fixed reference-free task legality; no correctness selection.
fallback: Retain exact baseline answer/reason/status after known invalid reply.
accounting: main_calls/tool_calls are new-run counts; prefix_actual fields count historical branch.
